description: Partners and other systems calling your public API endpoints (REST, GraphQL). Sends its share of the workload server to server, with a short timeout and SDK-style retries.
modeled: Open-loop arrivals: clients do not slow down when the system is slow
Per-attempt client timeout and bounded retries with exponential backoff
Its share of the workload, split from the same arrivals as the other client groups
Server-to-server internet delay as the latency of its link (default p50 10 ms / p95 30 ms one way)
notModeled: Per-consumer API keys and quotas (put a rate-limited gateway in front to model them)
